text:
jess-cs: Heads-up: enterprise-42 reporting intermittent 403s on signing and high tail latency after their nightly key rotation (02:15 UTC). They also say audit logs missing for 02:14-02:23 UTC and billing shows a spike. Adding @sam-sre @maria-crypto @nina-sec.
sam-sre: Can you paste sample request_id + API call? Any stack traces? We'll check CloudHSM session logs and VPC connectors.
jess-cs: Request id: req_9a8f7e. Sample error from customer: "sign: 403 Forbidden - KS_SESSION_INVALID". They attached SDK trace and a short log. Pasted below.
linh-support: Thanks, attaching customer's minimal repro they ran: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sign \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \
 -d '{"key_id":"key-abc-rotated","data":"..."}'
```
Response: 403, `{"error":"KS_SESSION_INVALID"}`.
maria-crypto: That error maps to failed HSM session after rotation; possible key handle stale. Did the rotation pipeline create new keyid mapping? Any async key-sync job?
sam-sre: I pulled CloudHSM node metrics around 02:10-02:30 UTC: reconnects ~3x, control-plane TLS renegotiation, and high latency spikes (p99 ~ 1.8s -> 4.3s). Also saw HSM 'session-terminated' events. Attaching snippet:
```
[02:16:07] cloudhsm-node-3 WARN session_drop id=0x1a3f reason=ROUTE_REFRESH
[02:16:08] cloudhsm-node-3 ERROR pkcs11_sign rc=CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID
[02:17:01] gateway INFO rotation job key=key-abc status=SUCCEEDED job_id=rot-2026-03-17-021500
```
maria-crypto: If rotation job completed while active sessions existed, older sessions can show invalid handles. We should ensure rotation uses ephemeral session draining and rebind. Repro idea: run continuous signing while trigger rotation; watch for CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID.
nina-sec: Also customer reported audit gap. Are our audit logs for HSM proxied events stored in CloudWatch? Check retention and ingestion lag. We need to confirm whether logs for 02:14-02:23 were ingested or lost.
sam-sre: I checked ingestion — logs were delivered but a downstream processor (audit-shipper) failed for 9m due to expired IAM token and backfill did not run. Root cause: token auto-rotate job didn't refresh in time after rotation. Opening infra ticket to backfill and reprocess.
jess-cs: Customer is asking for timeline and whether keys were fully rotated and if their old keys might be compromised. Need statement for compliance.
maria-crypto: Key rotation job succeeded, no key material leaked; old handles were invalidated but material stayed in HSM. Suggest communicating: "rotation completed, no evidence of exfiltration; session handle invalidity caused 403s and temporary latency; audit ingestion delay caused missing entries — we will backfill and provide logs."
sam-sre: Action items:
- [ ] backfill audit logs for 02:14-02:23 UTC (infra)
- [ ] add session-drain step to rotation pipeline (eng-runtime)
- [ ] surface billing spike analysis (billing)
- [ ] provide customer timeline and postmortem (cs)
maria-crypto: Quick mitigation — restart HSM gateway process on affected nodes to reclaim stale sessions. Doing controlled restart now on node-3.
deploy-bot: deployment: restart gate/node-3 by sam-sre triggered at 1799991310 — success.
linh-support: After restart customer reports retries succeed, p99 latency back to normal. They confirmed receipt of preliminary logs. Will ping when complete audit backfill is done.
nina-sec: I'll prepare a compliance note and coordinate with legal for the formal statement.
jess-cs: Thanks all. I'll send interim message to customer: short explanation + ETA for full logs (48h). cc @nina-sec
sam-sre: Follow-up: we also need a test to reproduce at scale and ensure rotation pipeline holds under concurrent sessions. Assigning to eng-runtime.
maria-crypto: I'll draft a rotation checklist (session drain, rotate KMS token, confirm audit-shipper refresh).
jess-cs: Closing loop: customer thanked us, monitoring for any further 403s. Will file postmortem once backfill done.
